title: KNOW YOUR ENEMY: GOD'S FOES & OURS

sense.text:
“The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee”: that is the pride of the white woman on the screen saying go back to Haiti, we built this, we built America, we don’t want you here. That pride deceives, and a white woman like this will fool a negro quick, the negro who does not know the history of America. The truth is, some of us are stupid, and she knows it; she is talking to a bunch of people who don’t know any history.

She will not tell you about the 66 million so-called American Indians they murdered to take this land. She will not tell you we are standing on stolen land. She will not tell you the reason Haiti is the way it is: the white man did that.

She is not talking to the Israelite, because we know who she is. Megyn Kelly is the devil the Bible speaks of, and she cannot help herself. She is talking to people who don’t know her history and don’t know where she comes from. This is what happens when our people do not open a book and read, and do not know their own history.

“And this is the blessing of Judah.” Judah is the only tribe that does not have a country to go to. The Haitian can get up and say, I’m going back to Haiti; the Jamaican can say, I’m going back to Jamaica. Judah cannot. That is why Jacob spoke in Genesis 49 of the neck of his enemies: Judah is going to live with the enemy.

“Hear, Lord, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people.” Judah is the one, not Levi, not Benjamin, not Issachar. Judah is the one who will be on the forefront fighting. The waking up is going to start with Judah, and Judah will wake up the rest of them. It goes deeper than that, because it also goes into Christ.

So Levi and Benjamin, coming here from the islands and from the United Kingdom and running their mouths against Judah, need to be quiet: they do not know the history. The media tells them Judah is the laziest, and some believe that garbage because they never open a book. They never hear that after slavery Judah was still getting lynched, nor about Jim Crow, redlining, the Black Codes and sharecropping, nor how many black towns the white people burned and flooded every time Judah tried to get away from them.

A tree does not begin at the leaves; it begins with a seed dropped in the dirt, at the root. When we look at the so-called African-American we look at the leaves and say they are lazy, they kill each other in Chicago. America does not tell you what it did to the root of the tree. No black man makes the guns, and no black man grows cocaine in his backyard. Before you open your mouth, find out what caused the problem.

“Let his hands be sufficient for him; and be thou an help to him from his enemies.”

That is why the class played Martin King and Malcolm X. They were Judah, and so were Marcus Garvey, Sojourner Truth, Nat Turner and Fred Hampton, but they did not fight only for Judah. “Bring him unto his people”: his people are not only the so-called African-American. The whole 12 tribes are Malcolm X’s people and Martin King’s people. These revolutionaries on this side of the world fought for all of us, and they paid with their lives, the same as the pan-African leaders who went against the powers that be.

It is because of them we have the little rights we have here; the so-called Haitian can stand in the street today and teach the Bible because of what Malcolm X did. So never speak evil against these men who sacrificed themselves. Judah is the one. Stop speaking evil against Judah: you can talk evil against the African-American, but not against Judah.

“If thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe to do all his commandments”: all of them, not some of them. Then “all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee.”

When Moses said this, the whole 12 tribes were together in the wilderness: Judah, Benjamin, Levi, Issachar, Ephraim, Manasseh, all of them. He said it to all 12. Some of you want to separate yourselves, but you cannot rise above your people. Even worth a trillion dollars, like that devil Elon Musk, you can never rise above your people.

“Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people, and thine eyes shall look, and fail with longing for them all the day long: and there shall be no might in thine hand.” That happened here, in Haiti, in Jamaica, in South America, wherever the Israelite is. It is a prophecy, and it happened to all of us.

“The fruit of thy land, and all thy labours, shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up”: this is still happening on the continent of Africa today.

“And thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed alway.” Today that is called colonized. America colonized Haiti; Africa is still colonized today, and the leaders who tell the white man to get out, like those of Mali and Niger, are the ones they try to kill.

White people cannot survive without black people. They know that; we do not. White people think a hundred years from now; black people think about tomorrow. It is no coincidence that every time black people said, leave us alone, we will do our own thing, the white man burned and flooded those black towns, in Oklahoma, in Georgia, all over. Esau understands what happens if he leaves us alone.

“And thou shalt become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword, among all nations whither the Lord shall lead thee.” Being called an African-American is a proverb and a byword. That is not your name: you are Judah. Being called a Haitian, a Jamaican or a Puerto Rican is the same thing. Ephraim, Benjamin, Levi: those are our names.

Meditate on it, because when Moses gave this all 12 were together. When something happens to one of us, it happens to all of us. If something happens to the so-called Haitian, it also happens to the so-called African-American. The white man understands divide and conquer; black people do not. Malcolm X taught that unity is what scares the oppressor; us divided does not scare white people.

The people from other countries who run their mouths about Judah do it because they do not know who they are themselves, so how would they know who Judah is? We are the same people. We are the Israelites; we all come from the same father, all under the covenant: Christ died for the 12 tribes of Israel. So there is no need to celebrate, oh yeah, let them deport them. That is not a good spirit to have, and Esau loves that thing.

“The stranger that is within thee shall get up above thee very high; and thou shalt come down very low.” The so-called African-American owns nothing here, and in Haiti they own nothing either. Don’t think a black country means they own everything.

Travel to Africa. Liberia is 99% black, but one company, a white man’s company and not a Liberian or African one, makes $1.5 billion in gold in one year, while the GDP of the whole country is $1.2 billion. Freedom for black people is an illusion, just like democracy is an illusion. They tell you that you are free on paper.

“He shall lend to thee, and thou shalt not lend to him: he shall be the head, and thou shalt be the tail.” Same thing here, same thing in Haiti: that has happened everywhere the Israelite is.

“Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee, in hunger”: you want food, you have to go to the enemy. In Haiti a handful of families control the food, and none of them is Haitian; if a Haitian wises up and tries to take part of it, they send somebody to kill him. “And in thirst”: the biggest water company in Haiti is not owned by Haitians. “And in nakedness, and in want of all things.”

This prophecy is for the whole 12 tribes. It wasn’t only for Judah, and it wasn’t only for the Haitians. No matter where we end up this curse follows us, so none of us is better than the other.

“And he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck.” The Haitian was in slavery under the French, and that is what the 1804 revolution was about. The so-called African-American had the chain on his neck the same way, and Jamaica the same.

“Until he have destroyed thee.” All of us have been destroyed as a people, destroyed in the mind. We believe whatever the media tells us about the African-American, that they are lazy and don’t want to work. When we ask who the enemy is, we point at the other black man. Show me in history where a Haitian ever lynched an African-American, where a Jamaican ever lynched a Haitian, where the African-American ever went to Haiti to kill the Haitian and destroy Haiti. Then how are we each other’s enemy?

“The Lord shall bring a nation against thee from far, from the end of the earth, as swift as the eagle flieth.” We always look at America first when we read this, because that is the land we are in and America’s sign is the eagle.

But all 12 were there when Moses said it. The French imperial eagle was carried into battle as a standard by the Grande Armée of Napoleon, and on 5 December 1804 he gave out eagles patterned after the standards of the Roman legions. 1804 is the year Haiti took its independence: when the French were at war with the Haitians, the eagle was there.

The Bible is a true book. The same way the African-American is under that eagle here, there was a time the Haitian was under that eagle too. That shows we are the Israelites.

“And the Lord shall scatter thee among all people”: no matter where you go, you will see the Israelite. Genesis 49 is the map of where each one was going to be: Haiti is Levi, America is Judah, Jamaica is Benjamin, yet you may find a Haitian here and a Judah there, because we are scattered.

“From the one end of the earth even unto the other”: that is the proof. The Israelite who says there are no Israelites in Africa sounds stupid; no matter where you go, we are going to be there.

“And there thou shalt serve other gods, which neither thou nor thy fathers have known”: you will serve the gods of the other nations. Our fathers did not know Christianity or a white Jesus, did not know Islam, Krishna or Buddha, and did not know Catholic trash like kissing the feet. Some Haitians believe voodoo is a religion; it was rooted in West African voodoo, developed among the enslaved in Haiti and mixed with Catholic elements.

The northern kingdom does the same thing: go to a Dominican or Hispanic restaurant and there is a little shrine in the corner, candles, and a statue with blonde hair and blue eyes. So the curse is against the whole 12 tribes.

“And the Lord shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships.” How did the Haitian get to Haiti? How did the Jamaican get to Jamaica, and how did we get here? The Haitians and the Jamaicans came in chains the same way the so-called African-American did, and the white man calls all of us negro.

When we teach in the street we usually speak of America, but this covers the whole 12 tribes. We are one people, and there should be no division in the midst of us.

precepts.why:
Some doubt that the so-called Haitians are Levi. “Simeon and Levi are brethren”: the whole 12 are brethren, so why name Simeon and Levi together? Because Simeon and Levi, the so-called Dominican and the so-called Haitian, are on the same island. In the end those two were going to be together: one part called Haiti, one part called the Dominican Republic, divided but on one island.

“Instruments of cruelty are in their habitations.” In Haiti the instrument of cruelty is called voodoo, and in the Dominican Republic it is called brujería.

“O my soul, come not thou into their secret; unto their assembly, mine honour, be not thou united.” Our forefather Jacob is saying, do not join them, because they use that thing to hurt their own people, their own brother. And it is garbage: if voodoo really worked, why not use it on white people to make them leave you alone? Use it on Donald Trump. They only use it on their own people because it is trash.

“Be not thou united”: they are not united. It used to be one island; now it is divided, Simeon on one part and Levi on the other, and they hate each other: the Dominican cannot stand the Haitian, and the Haitian cannot stand the Dominican. “For in their anger they slew a man” goes back to their history over their sister Dinah, and you need to know that history.

So it is not only Judah who serves other gods. Levi serves other gods too, and so does the northern kingdom, which is why the curse of serving other gods in Deuteronomy 28:64 is against the whole 12 tribes.

sense.text: “Because I have called, and ye refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no man regarded”: God called, and none of us responded.

“But ye have set at nought all my counsel”: God’s counsel is the law. We set it aside and said we don’t want the law; as a matter of fact the wicked pastors say do not keep the law. “And would none of my reproof.”

“I also will laugh at your calamity.” Levi, God is laughing at your calamity. What is happening to the so-called Haitian is not a coincidence; there is no coincidence with the Most High, and everything he does has a plan behind it.

This devil Donald Trump gets in office and wants deportation, and he will not stop there; when he leaves, the next one will not stop either. Nobody talks about all the people Obama deported, so many that Trump could never catch up. Obama sat in the seat of the devil and did the devil’s work, and Donald Trump does the same devil’s work: they all answer to Satan, as we answer to the Most High.

All we can do is pray for our people, that the Most High shows mercy. But our people must repent. There is no praying for the Haitian in the middle of sin, in the middle of voodooism, killing their own people. If you are evil, God sends evil towards you; if you are in darkness, God sends darkness. What is going on in Haiti right now is the result of sin.

“Never trust thine enemy”: God is telling us never to trust our enemies.

“For like as iron rusteth, so is his wickedness.” Drop a piece of iron in the water and it does not rust that same day; it takes time. Keep a snake as a pet and it might not bite you that same day, but one day it will, because that is the nature of a snake. Bring a lion home from the jungle and call him a pet; he is just waiting to get hungry.

That is the white man. Some of you marry them, some get killed by them, some make them your best buddies at your job and invite them to your house for drinks. The snake will not bite the same day and the iron will not rust the same day, but his wickedness is coming.

The white men’s own words show that Haiti is run by the U.S. State Department, and that it is not only Haiti. Now let the Bible say it.

“Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places; thus saith the Lord of hosts, They shall build, but I will throw down.” Edom is the so-called white people: Edom, Esau, that is his name in the Bible.

“And they shall call them, The border of wickedness.” That is what God says the so-called white people will be called. Wherever you see evil, they are right there: they are behind every evil on the planet. If you go outside and see a black man pull a gun and kill another black man, pull back the curtain and the white man is behind it, because that black man did not make that gun.

The black man is still responsible. But stop looking at the leaves of the tree and start looking at the root; the problem begins at the root, and that is what God is showing.
“Saith the Lord of hosts unto you, O priests, that despise my name.” That is talking about Levi, the so-called Haitian.

“Ye offer polluted bread upon mine altar.” That is how you know it is Levi: Levi was the priest, the one who offered the sacrifices. Offering “the blind for sacrifice” and “the lame and sick” shows how Levi got corrupt.
“And now, O ye priests, this commandment is for you.” “I will even send a curse upon you, and I will curse your blessings.” God sent a curse upon Levi, the so-called Haitian.

“That my covenant might be with Levi.” God had a covenant with Levi, and Levi broke it. Instead of helping the people, Levi brought the people to sin, so God broke the covenant with Levi.

“My covenant was with him of life and peace; and I gave them to him for the fear wherewith he feared me”: there was a time Levi feared the Most High.

“The law of truth was in his mouth”: there was a time Levi was righteous, a time the so-called Haitian was righteous. Not today; there is a lot of evil going on in the midst of them. “And did turn many away from iniquity”: Levi was the one who turned the other tribes from sinning, and now Levi does the opposite and causes the others to sin.

“For the priest’s lips should keep knowledge”: the knowledge is the law. “And they should seek the law at his mouth: for he is the messenger of the Lord of hosts.” There was a time Levi was the messenger.

“But ye are departed out of the way”: Levi departed from the law, from the message, from what the Most High wanted him to do. “Ye have caused many to stumble at the law”: Levi caused the other brothers and sisters, the other tribes, to sin. “Ye have corrupted the covenant of Levi”: Levi has been corrupted.

“Therefore have I also made you contemptible and base before all the people.” Of the 12 tribes, Levi is the base: Haiti is the poorest country in the hemisphere. Why? Sin.

The only way this changes is to repent and come back to the law of God. You want change in Haiti? Repent; that is the solution. And it is not only for Levi: Judah, Benjamin, the whole 12 tribes, if you want change, repent.

precepts.why:
This is what the Most High has for Levi: “he shall purify the sons of Levi, and purge them as gold and silver, that they may offer unto the Lord an offering in righteousness.” That is talking about repentance. Levi might be wicked as hell, but if they repent they are still going to get the kingdom: God is going to bring Levi back.

And today the high priest is Christ. You don’t have to go to Levi anymore; we only go to Christ.

sense.text:
It is not only Haiti. Everywhere the Israelite is, they make sure we stay in poverty; their own presentations say sub-Saharan Africa will be kept a raw material producer and impoverished.

“Happy art thou, O Israel: who is like unto thee, O people saved by the Lord, the shield of thy help, and who is the sword of thy excellency! and thine enemies shall be found liars unto thee.” That is what we see today: our enemies are found liars. Now we can open a book and read, and see that this Bible is about us and our people. This Bible is for the 12 tribes of Israel.

precepts.why:
Meditate on this scripture especially today, the day the so-called white man is celebrating: “So of thy people was accepted both the salvation of the righteous, and destruction of the enemies.”

Thy people is us, and we have to accept both. “The salvation of the righteous”: we are the righteous. “And destruction of the enemies”: you have to accept the destruction of the enemies too.

So don’t pray for America to stay in power, and don’t pray for peace. Pray for the destruction of your enemies. You must accept that; it is the only way you are going to get the kingdom.
God’s enemy is our enemy. “Thine hand shall find out all thine enemies”: God has a lot of enemies, just like the Israelite has a lot of enemies. “Thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee.”

“Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered: let them also that hate him flee before him. As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: as wax melteth before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.”

“But let the righteous be glad”: let the righteous, Israel, be glad. “Let them rejoice before God: yea, let them exceedingly rejoice.”

“Deliver me, O Lord, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man; which imagine mischiefs in their heart; continually are they gathered together for war.” “They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders’ poison is under their lips”: those are the enemies of God and of Israel.

“God is jealous, and the Lord revengeth; the Lord revengeth, and is furious; the Lord will take vengeance on his adversaries”: God will take vengeance on his enemies.

“And he reserveth wrath for his enemies.” God reserves wrath for America, for China, for Europe, for all the evil they did to our people.

“For, lo, thine enemies, O Lord, for, lo, thine enemies shall perish”: God’s enemies and our enemies shall perish, shall die. “All the workers of iniquity shall be scattered”: all evil shall be scattered.

“And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming: even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders.” The wicked will be revealed, and God is going to bring judgment on this place.

“The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool. The Lord shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.”

“Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power”: the scripture says we are going to be willing. That is the remnant.

Levi, you had better repent, so that when the destruction comes you do not fall in it.

sense.text: These are the prayers you should read for the destruction of your enemies, and that is what we are praying for today. “Plead my cause, O Lord, with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.”
“Let them not rejoice over me”: don’t let them rejoice over the Israelite, because that is what they are celebrating today.

precepts.why: “Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.” The same prayer for the destruction of the enemy.

“Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.” Read it again: evening, morning and noon we cry aloud for the destruction of the enemy. “God shall hear, and afflict them.”

“The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords.” That is the enemy: smooth words, and war in his heart.

“Let their table become a snare before them: and that which should have been for their welfare, let it become a trap.” “Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.” “Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.” Another prayer against the enemies of Israel.

A heavy chapter and a heavy prayer, read straight through while the pictures of slavery and of the killings of our people, by the police not too long ago, are shown.

“Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out”; “that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.” That is our prayer for America.

“Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from the Lord”: that is our adversary. “Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.” “For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save him from those that condemn his soul.”

sense.text: “For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth, saith the Lord God”: God has no pleasure in the death of the Israelite. “Wherefore turn yourselves, and live ye”: repent and live. Levi, repent.

precepts.why: “He that covereth his sins shall not prosper: but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy.” Whoever confesses and forsakes his sins shall have mercy: that is the turning that lets Israel live.
“The law of the Lord is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the Lord is sure, making wise the simple.” Turning and living is coming back to the law of God, the law that converts the soul.

sense.text:
“Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins.” This is not only talking about the so-called Haitian; it is talking about the whole 12 tribes. Christ is telling the whole 12 tribes the whole 12 tribes is no damn good: we have all sinned and come short of the glory of the Most High, and we all must repent and come back home.

It is read on this Sabbath because our people are entangled in foolishness, barbecuing and celebrating the so-called 4th of July, which has nothing to do with us. They forgot where they are.

“And that ye receive not of her plagues”: receive not America’s judgment. God will bring judgment here.

To Judah the so-called African-American, Benjamin the so-called Jamaican, Ephraim the so-called Puerto Rican, Simeon the so-called Dominican, Manasseh the so-called Cuban, who think what happened to the so-called Haitian will not happen to you: hear what Christ said. The 12 tribes are part of Christ’s DNA, so the whole 12 tribes are connected, and when one hurts we all hurt. The other nations understand unity; we don’t.

“The Galileans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.” Pilate was a white man, and he murdered many Israelites.

“Suppose ye that these Galileans were sinners above all the Galileans, because they suffered such things?” Jesus is speaking to the Israelites standing there: you think those Israelites from Galilee were worse sinners than any other Israelite because they died that way? So you think the 350,000 to 400,000 Haitians about to be deported are more wicked than everybody else?

“I tell you, Nay”: Christ says no. Those Haitians getting deported are not the most evil people on the planet, nor the most evil among the 12 tribes. “But, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish”: except you, Judah, repent, except all 12 repent.

Donald Trump is going to come after all of y’all; the white man is going to come after all of us. Judah says, I cannot get deported, but you really underestimate the white man, and you underestimate the devil. When the Bible says Esau is the devil, you may agree, but you have no idea what this man is capable of.

“Or those eighteen, upon whom the tower in Siloam fell, and slew them, think ye that they were sinners above all men that dwelt in Jerusalem?” Eighteen Israelites had a building fall on them and were all killed. When a disaster kills our people, as in Venezuela, do not say God allowed it because they were the most wicked; you forget the same happened in Haiti. Black people have short memories.

This will not be the last thing to happen to the Israelite. The Bible says two-thirds are going to die and one-third will make it: God will cut off the two-thirds so the one-third can look at it and say, I had better repent, I don’t want to end up like that.

“I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.” Except Judah repent, except Ephraim, Benjamin, Issachar, Zebulun, Manasseh repent, you are going to die too, because we are the 12 tribes of Israel, the sons and daughters of the living God, and this whole thing is about us.

So don’t be quick to celebrate what happened to the so-called Haitians. When you see evil happen to your people, never celebrate it; it can happen to you too. Yes, they come here and talk evil about Judah, but they don’t know any better, and there was a time you didn’t know any better either. Forgive them. None of you Israelites who have repented should ever have that spirit.
